reason: It's November, my apartment is empty until spring and so is my wallet, so €600 now for something that only pays back in summer is not happening. Maybe I'd think about it in February or March before the season starts.
objection: €600 is a big chunk of what I make in a year, and I'm not sure a site will actually pull guests away from Booking. People search Booking, not my name, so I could pay for a nice site that nobody finds.
would_change_my_mind: Being able to pay in two parts, half now and half after my first direct booking, or seeing another apartment owner near me who really got direct bookings from it.
